notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; a simulator has no hardware. MOCK PATH: the card prefers the upstream simulator, and the upstream simulator IS the sim backend of this family driver (GymnasiumDriver.open_native makes ctrl-aviary-v0 with gymnasium.make) - that path needs pybullet and gym_pybullet_drones, which are not importable where the gate ran, so the fake backend that the gate runs is the package's own pure Python aviary (fake.py), a re-implementation of CtrlAviary's spaces, dummy reward and flags and reset state. WARNINGS: the gate raises the five warnings expected of every Gymnasium family driver (PLAYBOOK.md section 8): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the pending seed and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values[*], and the seed of cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1); no unit can be added because the family derives those schemas. NOT COVERED: the horizontal and attitude dynamics, the four rotor forces, ground effect, drag, downwash, collisions and the URDF collision shapes (the fake integrates only the vertical force balance and the fidelity gaps say so); rendering, video recording, the GUI sliders and the ONBOARD CAMERA FRAMES rgb/dep/seg (the vision attributes are off by default); the other three environments of the same clone (velocity-aviary-v0, hover-aviary-v0, multihover-aviary-v0) and their RL action/observation types (ActionType PID/VEL/ONE_D_*, BaseRLAviary) are not bound; the sim backend and any comparison of the fake with the upstream PyBullet environment were never run. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests, and the action envelope is the environment's own action Box (0 to MAX_RPM, CtrlAviary.py:74-86), not an operator limit. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
